per_window.ps-ns: unresolved for SH3-3. The BMRB 7036 paper, read as an abstract, reports heteronuclear NOE above 0.7 at most SH3-3 residues despite a CD spectrum typical of a largely unstructured protein (R7036-J1, r1); no residues, values or conditions. Other-domain context only: native SH3-1 is ordered apart from its termini, T33 and loop tips (J5, r5), and acidified or 4AlaMut SH3-1 has more fast motion (J6, J7; r6, r7; 278 K, 800 MHz).
per_window.us-ms: search_insufficient for SH3-3 (J2). The only µs-ms statements concern the SH2 domain with phosphoephrinB2 peptides bound, abstract-only (J10, J11; r2-r4).
per_window.undetermined: Ultraweak SH3-3/PINCH-1 LIM4 complex (KD about 3 mM, abstract; J4, r11) is binding, not conformational exchange. Acidified and 4AlaMut SH3-1 populate non-native two-helix states (J8, J9; r8, r9). Not judged: the static SH3-1 versus Src SH3 packing comparison (r10), which proposes a folding requirement without kinetics.
